panels.title: Payments made
panels.description: Payments that went through in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

panels.title: Payments that succeed
panels.description: Of the payments the wallet was asked to make. Failed and unknown count against it; not having enough funds does not, since that is not Rayl failing.

targets.rawSql:
select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1)
from telemetry_events
where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown') and dimensions->>'error' <> 'insufficient_funds' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

panels.title: Open app → paid (typical)
panels.description: The headline speed number: cold start, scan, paid, without any tap. Half of such payments are faster than this. Empty until someone pays that way (Auto Pay, first payment after opening the app).

targets.rawSql: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'process_to_outcome_ms' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

panels.title: Wallet takes to pay (typical)
panels.description: From handing the payment to the wallet until it is confirmed. Half of the payments are faster than this.

targets.rawSql: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

panels.title: App opens
panels.description: Cold starts that reached the foreground.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'launch' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

panels.title: Where the time goes (typical, per step)
panels.description: The machine's share of a payment, step by step. The longest bar is where speeding up pays off. Aiming the camera and tapping are left out.

panels.title: Payments per day
panels.description: paid = went through. failed = the wallet said no. unknown = the wallet gave no answer. rejected = stopped before the wallet (for example not a valid invoice). dismissed = the user closed the confirmation.

panels.title: What goes wrong
panels.description: Payment attempts that did not end in a payment, by reason. Empty is good.

targets.rawSql:
select replace(dimensions->>'error', '_', ' ') as problem, count(*) as times
from telemetry_events
where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'error' <> 'none' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: How payments start
panels.description: scan = camera. input = pasted or typed. hub = started from a contact or shortcut in the Hub.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'source' as source, count(*) as payments
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: How payments are confirmed
panels.description: auto = paid without asking (Auto Pay). confirmed = the user tapped to confirm. amount entered = the user typed the amount.

targets.rawSql:
select replace(dimensions->>'confirmation', '_', ' ') as confirmation, count(*) as payments
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: By wallet
panels.description: Rayl's wallet next to Blink, NWC and Spark: how many payments, how reliable (not counting insufficient funds), how fast.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') as paid,
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid')
    / nullif(count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown') and dimensions->>'error' <> 'insufficient_funds'), 0), 1) as "succeed %",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid')) as "pays in (ms)"
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: New users: how far they get
panels.description: Fresh installs only; each is counted once per step. The biggest drop between two bars is where new users get stuck.

targets.rawSql:
select step, installs from (
  select case dimensions->>'step'
      when 'welcome' then '1 Opened the app'
      when 'app_onboarded' then '2 Finished the intro'
      when 'wallet_ready' then '3 Wallet ready'
      when 'funded' then '4 Added funds'
      when 'first_payment' then '5 Paid once' end as step,
    count(*) as installs
  from telemetry_events where name = 'onboarding' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1
) steps order by 1

panels.title: Fake doors: who wanted it
panels.description: Installs, not taps: each person counts once. Empty until the first fake door ships.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'door' as door,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'shown') as "saw it",
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'tapped') as "tapped it",
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'tapped')
    / nullif(count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'shown'), 0), 1) as "interested %"
from telemetry_events where name = 'fake_door' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: iPhone: which code reader is first
panels.description: On iPhone two code readers watch the camera at once: Apple's built-in one (avfoundation) and Apple's Vision. This is how often each one read the code first.

targets.rawSql: select dimensions->>'decoder' as reader, count(*) as wins from telemetry_events where name = 'scan' and dimensions ? 'runner_up' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: iPhone: how far behind the other reader is
panels.description: For each winner: how often the other reader also read the code before the scanner stopped, and how much later (typical). 'Never read it' with a long wait means the other reader really failed on that code; with a short wait it just ran out of time.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'decoder' as "first reader", count(*) as scans,
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'runner_up' = 'decoded') / count(*), 1) as "other also read it %",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'runner_up_lag_ms')::numeric)) as "other was later by (ms)",
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'runner_up' = 'missed') as "other never read it",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'runner_up_wait_ms')::numeric)) as "...after waiting (ms)"
from telemetry_events where name = 'scan' and dimensions ? 'runner_up' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Camera by phone model
panels.description: Finding the code includes the user aiming. Many frames at a normal ms per frame means the code was in view but hard to read, which is what camera tuning can fix. Frame figures are Android only.

targets.rawSql:
select device_model as phone, count(*) as scans,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'camera_start_to_first_frame_ms')::numeric)) as "camera starts in (ms)",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'first_frame_to_qr_ms')::numeric)) as "finds the code in (ms)",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'frames_analyzed')::numeric)) as "frames needed",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'frame_analysis_avg_ms')::numeric)) as "ms per frame"
from telemetry_events where name = 'scan' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 25

panels.title: App opens per day, by version
panels.description: How much the app is used and how fast a new version is taken up.
